about: Extra English commentary (merged into commentary_lines.json's by gen_commentary.py). {bat} = the batter's name, {bowl} = the bowler's, only at the start or the end of a line.
defended: Blocked, straight back to the bowler.
beaten: Oh, that was close to the edge.
He had no idea about that one.
left: Good leave, judged the line well.
single: Pushed into the gap, they take one.
Easy single, rotating the strike nicely.
Just dropped and run. Smart cricket.
{bat} works it away for a single.
two: They come back for the second.
Placed in the gap, two runs.
Hard running, and they make it back for two.
Pushing the fielder there, two more.
three: Great running between the wickets, three.
Chased down just short of the rope, three runs.
four: Didn't need to hit that hard. Pure timing.
six: Effortless. Just stood there and launched it.
Up, up, and over the rope!
edge: Off the edge, past the slips!
dropped: Oh, that should have been taken.
wide: Strayed down the leg side. Wide.
no_ball: That's a no ball, and a free hit to follow.
free_hit: Free hit. Nothing to lose here.
Free hit, can't be out except run out.
first_boundary_over: That's the first boundary this over.
And that's the release shot this over.
big_over: That over has changed the game.
